notes: Statutory operating cash flow includes principal operating cash flow plus other operating fund-manager redemptions.
Principal operating cash flow is explicitly a non-HKFRS measure and is not mapped to operatingCashFlow.
Headquarters premises purchases are separate from other fixed-asset and intangible purchases.
Other fixed-asset and intangible purchases are combined and cannot safely be mapped to pure PPE purchases.
Annual depreciation/amortisation adjustment includes impairment; interim wording is depreciation and amortisation. The combined generic field deliberately does not claim pure D&A.
Cash-flow cash excludes Margin Funds, Clearing House Funds, A-share cash and reserved Corporate Funds.
H1 2025 figures below are the comparative columns published in the official H1 2026 report.
FY2024 and H1 2024 official comparatives provide H2 2024, allowing June 2025 versus June 2026 TTM comparisons on the same statutory CFO and cash CapEx basis.
FY2025 common-stock cash issuance is zero because the annual report explicitly confirms no HKEX shares were issued; share-award scheme market purchases are not negative issuance.
H1 2026 policies are consistent with FY2025; newly adopted amendments had no material impact.
